ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels distributed across central lobe surfaces versus 30% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at trailing edges and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black pigmentation along the entire trailing edge; dense black mottling at both distal tips; scattered irregular black focal spots and streak-like markings across the white interior of both lobes; high-density dark pixels at the peduncle-fluke junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 75 degrees; vertex positioned at the central vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; right lobe trailing edge exhibits a significantly deep, irregular notch approximately one-third of the distance from the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a moderate convex curve extending to the tips; trailing edges show a pronounced concave trajectory towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular high-contrast nodules at both distal lobe tips (barnacle colonization); a singular, distinct circular ring-like scar ('O' shape) located in the upper-mid quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional linear rake marks (white and black pixel disruptions) across both lobes, with a high concentration of sub-parallel horizontal scars on the inner-mid regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, ragged topography at the right lobe tip suggesting minor tissue loss or heavy chronic scarring; circular ring-shaped lesion on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique high-contrast visual aesthetic characterized by exceptionally dense and well-defined rake mark patterns across the majority of the visible ventral surface.
